title: Soviet spy at 1950 Pearl Harbor demo; wounded prairie chicken routine

tellings.quote: You see, in 1950 during a demo in Pearl Harbor, Brown's work was compromised by a Soviet spy acting as a janitor.

plain: In 1950, during a demonstration at Pearl Harbor in Hawaii, the work of the inventor Townsend Brown was compromised by a Soviet spy posing as a janitor. Michels tells this in a documentary about Brown, drawing on The Man Who Mastered Gravity, a book by Brown's biographer Paul Schatzkin. It would mean the Soviets thought Brown's work worth spying on.
